face.name: 战地医师老兵
face.text: 在你施放一个神圣法术后， 召唤一个2/2并具有吸血的医师。
face.flavorText: 战争时期，军医也会带上自己的专属军医。

face.name: Veteran Warmedic
face.text: After you cast a Holy spell, summon a 2/2 Medic with Lifesteal.
face.flavorText: In times of war, warmedics bring their own medics.

face.name: 狂野炎术师
face.text: 在你施放一个法术后，&对所有随从造成1点伤害。
face.flavorText: 爆炸吧，宝贝儿！炸得越烂越好！让那些统治者去死吧！

face.name: Wild Pyromancer
face.text: After you cast a spell,& deal 1 damage to ALL minions.
face.flavorText: BOOM BABY BOOM! BAD IS GOOD! DOWN WITH GOVERNMENT!

face.name: 死亡寒冰
face.text: 在你施放一个法术后，&随机对两个敌人造成1点伤害。
face.flavorText: 死亡本就是冰冷的，朋友……放松，躺好，别的什么都不用做。

face.name: Deathchiller
face.text: After you cast a spell,& deal 1 damage to two random enemies.
face.flavorText: Man, death is like the most chill state... you've got nothing to do but relax.

face.name: 沼地蛇颈龙
face.text: 在你施放一个法术后，&获得圣盾。
face.flavorText: “记好了，被拍到的时候，一定要注意光影和虚化感。”

face.name: Marshland Thresher
face.text: After you cast a spell,& gain Divine Shield.
face.flavorText: "Just remember, when we pose for pictures, look very shadowy and grainy."

native_guard_review.event: Completed physical original PlayRecord and exact event source/player, same-player SPELL not countered. Actual HOLY qualifier only for Veteran, captured living receiver only for Thresher.
native_guard_review.windows: Original direct Veteran summon and captured Thresher shield retained. Pyromancer and Cold retain their real InvokeBehavior late current-board body window, including borrowed contexts.
native_guard_review.scope: No automatic cast qualification, no current-vs-captured window flattening, no new public interpreter or state fields.
